'''Analysis''' was a department within the [[Intentions]] branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. The largest department of the Intentions branch, Analysis analyzed data provided by [[Cryptology]], [[Interrogation (Alliance Intelligence)|Interrogation]] and [[Operations (Alliance Intelligence)/Legends|Operations]] to determine whether the information was accurate or false. Analysis also prepared intelligence reports for [[Sector/Legends|sector]] intelligence units, as well as daily briefings for the [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]] and the [[Supreme Allied Commanders]].<ref name="RASB" />

In the beginning, Analysis was swamped with information that it could not hope to process; too many reports and not enough personnel to sift through everything. As a result, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] and sector forces were woefully underinformed about [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] intentions and plans. To remedy the situation, a sub-unit called [[Triage]] was formed with a single goal&mdash;to pre-judge all information on its usefulness at the point of entry, filing and discarding any report that was not obviously vital. While this system no doubt caused many important and useful reports to be discounted, Intelligence operatives believed it was better to act on partial information as quickly as possible rather than wait for the data to be processed and most likely out of date.<ref name="RASB" />

Analysis HQ was located with the High Command, and every [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]] Headquarters had an Analysis office on site, as did the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Analysis was staffed by hundreds of operatives, including [[statistician]]s, [[Translator/Legends|interpreters]], [[correlator]]s, and retired field agents, support by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Analysis offices separate from the main headquarters focused on information relating to their area of operation, taking the load of the main Analysis office and allowing data to be acted on quicker by local forces.<ref name="RASB" />

The Analysis office was responsible for the issuing of the [[SecuriDex]] files on potential threats to the Alliance. Despite being issued by Analysis, SecuriDexs were not authored solely by Analysis staffers. Usually, they were written by active [[operative]]s within [[Passive Operations]] and [[Systems Operations]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
